info.about: Odin Sphere is an action role-playing game developed by Vanillaware for the PlayStation 2. It was published by Atlus in 2007, and by Square Enix in 2008.
info.trivia: Vanillaware's remake of the PS2 game, redrawn for HD with a reworked battle system.
info.why: The Vita version was the smallest run of the three platforms, and Vita physical releases dried up soon after.
